hook.text: This, then, is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be honored as holy,

short350: Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) in Javanese, in Divine Voice™ Color — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking. Our Father's words in blue, the Son's in red, the Spirit's in purple. A complete 66-book Javanese Bible, paperback and hardcover, made to be given.
Iki Kitab Suci cithakan kang kapisan kang nuduhake marang kowe sapa kang lagi ngandika. Pangandikane Rama kita nganggo BIRU, pangandikane Sang Putra nganggo ABANG, pangandikane Sang Roh nganggo UNGU.

Luwih saka satus taun aksara abang wis nuduhake ing ngendi Sang Putra ngandika. Nanging Rama kita ngandika luwih akeh — ing Kitab Suci basa Jawa iki 125,905 tembung ing 5,609 ayat. Nganti saiki kabeh pangandikane dicithak nganggo mangsi ireng kang padha karo daftar turun-tumurun. Panjenengane wis ngandika wiwit kawitan; durung ana Kitab Suci kang nate nuduhake marang kowe ing ngendi.

Werna iku tandha kagungan, dudu tandha pethikan. Pangandikane Rama kita tetep kagungane ing lambene sapa wae kang ngaturake kanthi setya; tembung kang ora tau dingandikakake Panjenengane ora diwarnani; cariyos tetep ireng.

Nalika para sakabate nyuwun pirsa kepriye carane ndedonga, Sang Putra ora paring rumus, nanging paring Rama: “Dhuh Rama kawula ingkang wonten ing swarga, asma Paduka mugi kasucekna” (Mateus 6:9). Sakabehe ing Kitab Suci iki mili saka tembung siji iku. Lan kita padha sesambat: “Abba! Rama!” (Rum 8:15).

Panjenengane ora adoh. Panjenengane ora kuciwa marang kowe. Panjenengane iku Ramamu ing swarga, lan kowe iku putrane kang kinasih. Yen tembung ‘bapak’ ora nglipur atimu, Kitab Suci iki mligi kanggo kowe: Rama kang kawedharake ing kaca-kaca iki dudu wewayangane kabapakan manungsa kang rusak; saka Panjenengane saben brayat ing swarga lan ing bumi nampa jenenge.

Kitab Suci jangkep ing sajilid — 66 kitab, 1,189 bab, 31,087 ayat; ora ana siji kang ilang. Pambuka saka Sang Rama kanggo saben kitab, 1,361 cathetan kanggo para maos dudu kanggo para sarjana, lan kaca pisungsung kanggo nulis jenenge wong kang kokwenehi bebingah.

Terjemahan kang setya saka basa Ibrani, Aram lan Yunani asline; saben edisi katerjemahake saka Father's Heart Bible™. Ukuran 6 x 9 inci, Sampul Kertas lan Sampul Atos, dicithak warna. Bebingah, pangeling-eling, warisan.
Kanggo saben brayat lan pasamuwan Jawa ing Jawa Tengah, Jawa Timur lan Yogyakarta, ing saindhenging Indonesia lan ing manca negara — supaya padha krungu swarane Rama ing basane dhewe.
Tampanana Ramamu. Rungokna swarane. Panggalihe tumuju marang kowe.

faq.q: Is the Javanese edition the complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, Genesis to Revelation, in Javanese, 1176 pages, full color throughout, in hardcover and paperback.

faq.q: How was the Javanese edition translated?
faq.a: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™. The Father's Heart Bible™ itself is translated from the original languages; the Javanese edition is translated from it, so it follows the same text and carries the same Divine Voice Color.

In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read the Javanese text before I buy?
faq.a: Yes. The whole Javanese Bible is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read/jv.
